storyboard.hero_sub1: Storyboarding is where imagination becomes visible. It is the moment ideas leave the script and begin to take shape on screen.
storyboard.hero_sub2: The faster you can explore, refine, and align around those ideas, the stronger the production becomes.
storyboard.problem_p1: Traditional storyboarding is powerful but slow. Once drawn, boards can become rigid. Iteration takes time. Collaboration happens outside the frame.
storyboard.problem_p2: AI-only tools move fast, but often without continuity or control. They generate options, not direction. Creative teams are left sorting through outputs instead of shaping intent.
storyboard.problem_quote: This is not just a tooling issue. It is a creative workflow issue.
storyboard.features_desc: Storyboarding inside Pzaz combines flexibility with control — everything you need to move from rough concept to production-ready boards.
storyboard.feat1_desc: Generate unlimited AI-assisted shots within a scene to rapidly explore visual directions.
storyboard.feat2_desc: Iterate on an existing frame without losing composition or continuity.
storyboard.feat3_desc: Adjust framing, scale, and camera distance with precision.
storyboard.feat4_desc: Switch between black-and-white and colour outputs to match your creative intent.
storyboard.feat5_desc: Design reusable characters, locations and visual elements that persist across your project.
storyboard.feat6_desc: Create and edit animatics directly from any scene, adjust shot timing and preview pacing instantly.
storyboard.feat7_desc: Share secure, view-only animatic links with stakeholders for fast, frictionless feedback.
storyboard.feat8_desc: These tools are not isolated — they are part of a continuous workflow that supports experimentation first and precision later.
storyboard.cta_desc: Storyboarding should feel dynamic, collaborative and fast. It should help ideas grow, not restrict them.
storyboard.cta_body: With Pzaz, creative momentum and production structure work together. You explore freely. You refine deliberately. You align naturally.
storyboard.cta_bottom: Edit the film before you shoot it.
